text:
Morgan: Proposing a low-risk dry-run for the quarterly entitlement prune next Tue 16:00 UTC. Objectives: validate candidate selection heuristics, ensure KMS audit signals are captured, and confirm rollback works end-to-end. Feedback?
Priya: Strong +1. Suggest dry-run only (no actual removals). Produce a CSV of candidates and evidence links for owners to review.
Tej: Will run `entitlement-scan --min-last-use 180d --ownerless` and output CSV columns: principal, role, last_seen, owner, proposed_action, evidence_url. Will gpg-sign artifacts.
Ana: Need an automated rollback toggle. Ill add `scripts/rollback-prune --ticket $TICKET` that rebinds roles back using recorded diffs.
Jane-SRE: What exact audit lines should we look for in Cloud Logging? Plan to validate ingestion and latency.
Priya: KMS parity is critical. Expect protoPayload.methodName like `asymmetricSign` and authenticationInfo.principalEmail set to the principal. Also capture resourceName and serviceName.
Jane-SRE: Got it. Ill add a log-based metric for late ingestion: `kms_ingest_latency_ms` and alert if >120000ms.
audit-bot: Created ticket SEC-PRUNE-DRYRUN-2026, checklist attached, owners notified with 72h ack window.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled on staging principals with tag `prune-ok` at 2026-07-21T16:00Z. Dry-run first, apply only after manual GO.
Tej: Add canary guardrails: restrict to `env=staging`, limit to 10 principals, and monitor `failed_deployments` and `support.access-prune` tickets for 24h.
Ana: Also capture RBAC diffs via `kubectl auth reconcile --export-diff` and store in artifacts/diffs/. That simplifies rollback.
Morgan: Post-dry-run actions: security will review owner feedback, then schedule phased apply. Owners get 3 business days to respond or item gets escalated to manual review.
Priya: Ensure KMS key ACLs are not modified; if any temporary keys are spun up, revoke and rotate. Include a parity check between Cloud Audit Logs and our entitlement event stream.
Jane-SRE: Will validate logs, ingestion timestamps, and produce a short post-run log report.
Morgan: Sounds good. Tej produce the candidate CSV by EOD Mon; Ana validate rollback; Priya coordinate owner pings. Reconvene Tue 14:00 UTC for signoff. :white_check_mark:
